summary: Created hq/polsia_client.py (PolsiaClient class with 9 endpoints) and hq/tests/test_polsia_client.py (13 tests). Implementation: httpx-based REST client for Polsia Fork API v1 with X-API-Key auth, env-configurable defaults, and exception wrapping. Tests use MagicMock for sync httpx.Response behavior, covering all endpoints, auth headers, filters, error handling, empty responses, and env configuration. 13/13 tests passing, ruff clean.
